author: Spread
name: Segment ring
description: A 270° ring of segments that light up with the value (boost, charge, level).
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 190"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.seg{fill:none;stroke-width:12;stroke-dasharray:3.2 1.4}.off{stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.14}.on{stroke:url(#sg)}.m{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:16;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100)}.big{font-size:58px;fill:#ffb020}[data-level="9"] .big,[data-level="10"] .big{fill:#ff6a2a}</style><defs><linearGradient id="sg" x1="0" y1="1" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff7a1a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffd23f"/></linearGradient><mask id="sm"><path class="m" d="M49.09 148.91A72 72 0 1 1 150.91 148.91" pathLength="100"/></mask></defs>
<path class="seg off" d="M49.09 148.91A72 72 0 1 1 150.91 148.91" pathLength="100"/><path class="seg on" d="M49.09 148.91A72 72 0 1 1 150.91 148.91" pathLength="100" mask="url(#sm)"/>
<text x="100" y="118" text-anchor="middle" class="num big">{{value}}</text><text x="100" y="168" text-anchor="middle" class="cap" style="font-size:11px">{{label}}</text></svg>
